title: Name every review omission on the exact frozen or live range
preconditions: A review range contains covered, uncovered, and newly pushed changed lines.

steps.action: Open review coverage for the live pull request range.
steps.expected_result: Every unexplained changed line is listed with its exact file, side, range, and current totals.

steps.action: Push a new changed line without adding Item evidence.
steps.expected_result: The new line appears as uncovered and no completeness verdict is inferred.

steps.action: Freeze the review after merge and reopen its coverage.
steps.expected_result: Coverage returns to the frozen reviewed range and later source changes do not alter history.

expected_result: Pass when omissions are exact for live and frozen ranges and remain findings rather than approval; fail if an unexplained line disappears, stale evidence counts as coverage, or history follows later code.
